answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 8 times its size, so a group of 86 keys loses far more than 86 single identities would. The relic graph is rebuilt each epoch, as a result the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the mesa audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the falcon checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
